title: Existence and non-existence of nonradial solutions to an elliptic equation on hyperbolic space with critical and subcritical nonlinearities
summary: In this article, we study the semi-linear elliptic problem: \begin{equation*} -Δ_{\mathbb{B}^N} u \, - \, λu = |u|^{p-1}u, \quad u \in H^{1}(\mathbb{B}^N), \end{equation*} where $N \geq 3$, $λ> \frac{N(N-2)}{4}$, and $1 \frac{(N-1)^2}{4}$, based on a quantitative orbit packing condition.
